title: Notes
emptyNotes: There are no notes yet. Create a new note to begin.
emptyTrashDescription: Deleted notes appear here until you empty the trash.

errors.generic: The action could not be completed ({{code}})
errors.notFound: The note no longer exists. The list was reloaded.
errors.notFoundRecovered: The note no longer existed; your text was saved as a new note.

confirmEmptyMessage: Notes in the trash will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
emptyArchivedDescription: Notes you archive will appear here.

vault.notice: Content is encrypted on this computer. The title remains visible: do not put sensitive information in it. Without the password or security answers, recovery is impossible. A short password is easier to guess offline; we use scrypt and a delay after repeated failed attempts.
vault.rules: Use 6–10 characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a special character.
vault.question: Security question {{number}}
vault.waitAgain: Invalid credentials. Wait before trying again.
vault.invalid: Could not complete the action. Check your password or answers and try again.
vault.unlockFirst: Unlock the vault to make this note private.
vault.saveFailed: The latest changes could not be saved. Saving will be retried when you edit again.
vault.draftRestored: The latest changes were not saved; they have been restored so you can save them

credential.warning: Passwords will no longer be encrypted. Remove privacy?
